text:
```yaml
name: Repomix GitHub Action Workflow

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  repomix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run Repomix
      uses: repomix/repomix-action@main
      with:
        compress: true

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: repomix-output
        path: repomix/output
        retention-days: 30
```
